feeds.title: Tasty Chomps
feeds.description: Tasty Chomps is dedicated to finding the tastiest bits and pieces in Orlando as well as chronicling the latest foodie happenings and reviews. Founded by Ricky Ly, Tasty Chomps is a food and restaurant blog finding culinary adventures throughout Central Florida and around the world.

feeds.title: Eats by the Beach
feeds.description: Covers quick and easy homestyle meals and recipes made in Millie's little kitchen on the beach. From comfort food to chic international recipes, they make it all.

feeds.title: Lemon Hearted
feeds.description: Lemonhearted is one of Orlando's top lifestyle and food blogs covering local restaurants, local makers, travel guides, small business interviews, and life in the City Beautiful. Linz started LemonHearted back in 2013 as a way to get more connected to Orlando as it began to thrive. She wanted to focus on supporting the local businesses that were redefining the city.

feeds.title: Orlando Sentinel » food & restaurants
feeds.description: Orlando restaurants and food news, plus Central Florida reviews and recipes from the Orlando Sentinel. The Orlando Sentinel is the primary newspaper of Orlando, Florida, and the Central Florida region. It was founded in 1876 and is currently owned by Tribune Publishing Company.

feeds.title: Orlando Food Critic
feeds.description: An educated and unbiased opinion about local food and beyond. We are here to open your eyes to a new world of food hidden by all the loud noises of the media and help you get out of your comfort zone with our unique assistance.

feeds.title: Orlando Weekly » Food + Drink
feeds.description: Explore Orlando restaurant reviews, restaurant openings, dining, local breweries, and local wineries news. Orlando Weekly, published every Wednesday, is Central Florida's alternative source for news, views, arts and entertainment.

feeds.title: Eat Local Orlando
feeds.description: Eat Local Orlando, Orlando food blog, focused on finding new locally owned non-chain restaurants and food trucks in Orlando and Winter Park, documenting, photographing and reviewing them and their foods.

feeds.title: Orlando Weekly » Food News
feeds.description: Get the latest updates on restaurants and food places in Orlando in this section. Orlando Weekly is your free source for Orlando and Florida news, arts and culture coverage, restaurant reviews, music, things to do, photos, and more.

feeds.title: The Sanford Vegan Blog
feeds.description: Your hub for North Orlando's up-and-coming vegan community, culture, and cuisine! Run by Allison van Tilborgh. Allison van Tilborgh explores vegan food recipes and plant-based dining in North Orlando.

feeds.title: Orlando food tourist
feeds.description: Explore my blog to know more about various food places around Orlando along with recipes. I'm Jess, the Orlando Food Tourist. Much like a tourist would look for the most exciting experiences in a city, I've dedicated my free time to uncovering Orlando's best food spots. If something is smothered in cheese, made with a family recipe, or is as large as my face, chances are I plan to try it.

feeds.title: Go Epicurista Blog
feeds.description: Let's talk great restaurants, one of a kind special events, bucket list foodie travel, easy entertaining tips and recipes. I'm Christina, a hospitality consultant, freelance writer, food & travel enthusiast, brand cheerleader, ice cream fanatic, chocoholic, and eternal optimist on a mission to #MakeSomedayHappen one delicious bite, sip and trip at a time.

feeds.title: Edible Orlando
feeds.description: Discover Orlando's local food stories on innovative restaurateurs, chefs and businesses which make the city a great home for foodies. Through thoughtful stories and delicious recipes produced right here in Central Florida, the magazine and website will inform and inspire us about the bounty in our own backyard. An indispensable guide for people who are passionate about food, edible Orlando will be a feast for the senses!

feeds.title: Scott Joseph Orlando Restaurant Guide
feeds.description: An online source for restaurant news and reviews from Scott Joseph, the most trusted critic in Central Florida.

feeds.title: Eating Orlando
feeds.description: A gastronomical road trip across the land of Orlando, Florida. Adventures include the surrounding Central Florida region and beyond. Honest, trust-worthy restaurant reviews and info with no pretense. Join Orlando's favorite food blog as the expedition continues Eating Orlando one restaurant at a time.
